svg.text: JAX-Native LLM Post-Training - Tune-in-JAX - google/tunix - JAX AI Stack alignment layer
Global RL workflow - resource control - metrics logger
In-memory buffer: evaluated samples stream to trainers
Sync or async rollout / inference / train overlap
RLCluster: actor, critic, reference, reward roles
Weight updates via Optax - LoRA/PEFT support
Orbax checkpoint manager - custom loss via registry
Rollout: vanilla JAX / vLLM TPU / SGLang-JAX backends
Inference: ref logprobs, critic values, reward scoring
rollout_engine in ClusterConfig - weight sync to rollout
Weight sync: reshard across meshes - backbone sharing between actor/ref - push to rollout engines
Config-driven pipeline - Flax NNX model graph - Orbax checkpointing
Step 1: Config - dataset URL, model params, trainer hyperparams, ckpt freq
Step 2: Dataset Iterator - TFDS / Parquet / custom - tokenized batches
Step 3: Model load - nnx.Graph from params - Gemma/Llama/Qwen/MaxText/custom
Step 4: Trainer loop - forward + loss + Optax AdamW update (LoRA optional)
Step 5: Orbax CheckpointManager save + Metrics Logger export - repeat
Also: DPO/ORPO preference tuning - DistillationTrainer (logit + attention transfer)
White-box design: customize training loop without deep abstraction layers
RL Loop + Colocated vs Disaggregated Execution
RLCluster role_to_mesh controls device allocation and concurrency pattern
Rollout Workers generate trajectories (vLLM / SGLang-JAX / vanilla JAX)
Inference Workers: rewards, ref logprobs, critic values - into Train Data Queue
Trainers update actor/critic - weight sync / reshard to rollout mesh - loop
Agentic RL: multi-turn agent-env loop - overlap inference latency with tool execution
L6 - Hardware Layer & JAX AI Stack Position
Cloud TPU v4/v5/v6 - multi-host GPU - Pathways scale-out - between Flax/Optax and MaxText in JAX AI stack
Init path: config load - RLCluster mesh setup - model load/reshard - rollout engine init - Pathways connect
Step path: rollout generate - inference score - queue batch - train update - weight sync - metrics - repeat
Sources: google/tunix - tunix.readthedocs.io/design - Google Developers Blog 2025 - Cloud TPU JAX AI stack docs
